[[Scythe of the Hierophant]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from the [[Hierophant's Chest]], which appears after defeating [[Duncan the  Black]] in [[Slavers' Exile]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (20% chance)
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:Two-handed

== Skin ==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Raven Scythe]], but [[dye]]d black.

== Replica ==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Raven Scythe]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
*Black [[dye]]
